scope: Pure two-role discovery-versus-AEEP qualification component assembly only. Does not create plans, conformance, qualification, three-way access, or execution authority.

input_contract.profile_document: Must carry source_digest equal to this source pin, a current pair.control/pair.treatment of complete ExecutorSpec documents, and exactly current callback_documents_by_role for those two profiles.
input_contract.callback_bindings: Must be fresh operator-produced callback documents for the supplied current worker digests. The helper compares the current CodexDynamicTools implementation fingerprint, one call/10 seconds, READ authority, exact 1-attempt/10-second scope limits, artifact binding, and declaration digests. It never instantiates a callback service or calls its handler.
input_contract.shared_spreadsheets_definition: Exact b-shared-spreadsheets.v1 descriptor: pinned current worker image; canonical /opt Spreadsheets skill; separate /etc symlink path; /opt runtime; exactly one allowed alias name mapped to the canonical /opt file; exact skill digest; pandas/openpyxl versions; both required dependency expectations.
input_contract.shared_physical_skill_inventory: Caller must pass discovery and aeep maps that are each exactly {canonical /opt skill path: reviewed skill SHA}. This is expected metadata, not an observation; the worker collector must independently establish actual inventory and /etc alias resolution.
input_contract.common_inventory: Emitted exactly as {spreadsheets_bundle: content_digest(shared_spreadsheets_definition)} for the report-local WorkerComponentDefinition contract.
input_contract.selected_worker: Required exact worker digest for the treatment/AEEP role. Other selections reject.
input_contract.qualification_exposure: Required argument must be exactly required; treatment invocation must target the single declaration actually added between control and treatment callbacks.

checks_in_assembler: Verifies current source digest before assembly.

Requires both exact Luna/xhigh profiles to share the descriptor image, reviewed skill digest/files, model/effort and shared physical skills; validate_worker_pair checks distinct two-role worker identities and credential volumes.

Derives callback inventories from exact declarations; validates current implementation fingerprint, matching worker and artifact, exact one-call/10-second READ scope; requires control declarations unchanged and treatment to add exactly one tool.
Builds and validates DifferentialEnvironment with no physical candidate path and the dynamic-only candidate delta.
Builds and validates ComposedPairDefinition and emits the worker collector component shape.
prerequisites_before_later_setup_or_camp: A separate exact reviewed same-grant setup must supply fresh B worker configs and callback documents; do not reuse the old eaa profile as current evidence or fabricate scope/backend identities.

The shared task instructions must be identical and neutral/optional-capable so they remain valid for later optional-exposure value trials; the assembler preserves rather than rewrites supplied instructions.

Fresh execution-backed boundary and composed callback observations, independent review, protected grader and a separate required-exposure 8/28/105 qualification plan remain necessary. This assembly is not any of those.
A later normal/discovery/AEEP value definition requires separate three-role evidence and all-pairs worker identity/credential-volume checks; this assembler is deliberately two-role only.
If production source changes, this helper rejects the changed digest and needs a new exact source-bound review.

static_validation.ruff: python3 -m ruff check --select F821,F823 on the assembler and source-repinned producer: pass
static_validation.ast: ast.parse on those two report-local scripts: pass

limitations: The historical current-composed-profiles.json and original producer are design references only; their source digest is older and their physical-skill delta is not reused.
A self-asserted inventory or declaration digest does not prove permissions, model exposure, host-issued callback behavior, conformance, task success or qualification.
A separately identified comparison.py three-role validation gap is outside this two-role assembler and blocks later three-way value preparation until addressed under a new source freeze.
